reason: The patch adds `schedulingType` to `CalendarEvent` (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts:182) and sets it once (packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1074); a repo-wide search finds no read of it on a CalendarEvent, since every other `.schedulingType` access is on an eventType object (e.g. handleNewBooking.ts:992, 1077). It only travels onward through `...evt` spreads, including the webhook payloads at handleNewBooking.ts:1755 and 2297.
